author: Video Advice
description:
Bill Cooper spent years collecting information, connecting events, and trying to make sense of a much bigger picture.

Across countless broadcasts and lectures, he spoke about power, secrecy, war, surveillance, propaganda, institutions, and the direction he believed the world was heading. Many of these ideas were scattered across hours of recordings — heard separately, they can seem unrelated. Put together, they reveal the pattern Cooper believed he was seeing.

This 90-minute compilation brings some of those moments together in one place.

He connected the dots. He laid out the pattern. And decades ago, he told his audience what he believed would come next.

Whether you agree with Bill Cooper or not, hearing these recordings together — with the benefit of hindsight — gives them an entirely different perspective.

Watch until the end and decide for yourself.

William “Bill” Cooper (1943–2001) was an American radio broadcaster, author, and conspiracy theorist best known for Behold a Pa
title: Bill Cooper Said These 3 Events Would Come Next… Decades Ago
